business.description: RACE Eco Chain Limited operates in waste management, PET recycling, biomass briquettes, and recycled products. The company collects, aggregates, and supplies recyclable waste (primarily PET bottles) to recyclers, and is forward integrating into PET washing and recycling through its subsidiary Ganesha Recycling Chain Private Limited. It also converts biomass residues into briquette fuel and develops recycled products under the RESTORE brand.

Strengthen the pan-India network; expand collection infrastructure; scale digital connectivity via RACE Eco App; drive behavioural change; build future-ready suppliers; build PET washing capacity through Ganesha Recycling Chain; produce quality PET flakes; capture greater value; scale biomass; grow RESTORE
